name: k8s-manifestlens-monorepo
description: Explains Kubernetes YAML in plain English and flags risky settings. Local-first and offline.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @k8s-manifestlens/core && npm run build -w k8s-manifestlens && npm run build -w @k8s-manifestlens/web && npm run build -w k8s-manifestlens-vscode && npm run build -w @k8s-manifestlens/action
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
